$note: Sync stamp for the vendored KnowledgeNetwork Design System snapshot. The DS is a Claude Design project with NO native version/release and NO per-file hashes in its manifest, so this file IS the diffable version marker of what state we adopted. To check for drift: re-read the DS via /design-sync, re-hash, and compare against `tokens.files` below; to adopt a change, re-vendor and update the hashes + syncedAt here. Graduating to a properly published/semver'd dependency is tracked in issue #66.

tokens.note: Token files are mostly verbatim copies but one has diverged. Hashes below are the last-verified DS fingerprints; re-read the DS via /design-sync to detect further DS changes. 2026-08-05 re-sync: colors.css adopted contrast pass; 2026-08-08: typography.css adopted the 2026-08-05 DS addition (--ls-caps: 0.12em added, --ls-eyebrow aliased to it — every all-caps string in the system carries --ls-caps, a system-level rule not a per-component one). 2026-08-09 re-sync: all 7 files re-hashed and the recipe pinned down (see hashRecipe) — base/colors/elevation/fonts/motion reproduce their recorded fingerprints exactly, so they are unchanged and verbatim; typography.css is byte-identical to the DS and its NEEDS_RECOMPUTE marker is now a real hash. spacing.css keeps a LOCAL deviation, but the reason has INVERTED: the DS removed the dead --road-question-h / --road-tab-h (we converge) and corrected --road-head-h 28px -> 44px explicitly to adopt our old local value, except that value is now one revision stale — #70/#86 (2d59ac3) added the description row and grew the title, so AuthorRoad.tsx:84 headH() = HEAD_TITLE(28) + HEAD_DESC(20) + HEAD_COMBO(24) = 72px. We hold 72px; the road owns its own constants. Do NOT adopt 44 back. Re-reported on drift-log #74. 2026-08-11: --road-head-h is now DEAD in the app either way — the open card's head wraps, so AuthorRoad computes its height per card via headRows() and no source reads the token. The 44-vs-72 divergence is moot until something consumes it again. 2026-08-11 colors.css re-vendored: --border-hair 0.13 -> 0.17 and --border-rule 0.20 -> 0.25, restoring the file to byte-verbatim (every other line already matched). This was SILENT drift of the worst kind: the recorded fingerprint (89d70a85...) was the hash of our own stale copy, not of the DS file, so the mechanical check that exists precisely to catch this was vouching for the divergence. The DS flagged --border-hair; --border-rule was a second drift nobody had noticed. New fingerprint eec676c8... The hashRecipe was re-verified against base.css first, which still reproduces its recorded hash exactly.
tokens.hashRecipe: sha256 of the file's bytes with CRLF normalized to LF. This repo has core.autocrlf=true, so the working tree is CRLF while git blobs and the DS originals are LF — hashing the working-tree file raw yields a machine-local fingerprint that will never match the DS. Verify the recipe before trusting a mismatch: `tr -d '\r' < src/tokens/base.css | sha256sum` must reproduce base.css below.
